title: Repurposing Nitazoxanide to Manage Severe Bronchiolitis in a 9-Month-Old Infant
content: Lower respiratory tract infections caused by viruses are a leading cause of death in children under one year old. This communication describes, for the first time globally, a real-life practice of how nitazoxanide and Kelleni’s protocol can safely manage infants over six months old with viral lower respiratory tract infections.
